name: Opportune Strike (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Magus 15, critical strike arcana

Benefit: Whenever the magus scores a hit with a melee weapon when making an attack of opportunity, he may cast a spell with a range of touch as an immediate action, and then make a touch attack with that spell against the target of the attack of opportunity as a free action. The magus can use this ability once per day.
